case: ome-zarr-thin: familiar development case, not holdout
treatment: Complete bundle: incrementally maintained whole findings + host identity/revision/snapshot/current rendering + same-Goal structural receipts; not representation alone.
control_feedback: Native file write/read/error results only; no host structural or semantic feedback. Original observations-then-current-draft with model-saved snapshots/history.

capacities.scope: I2 familiar-case finite output capacities only; not inherited D1 limits or universal product defaults
capacities.counter_meaning: 64 is the store acknowledgement ceiling, counting valid/invalid initial and revision requests together. Native failed writes, surviving unsubmitted requests and overflow are separately included in observed attempt/usage inventory; they are never dropped or called free replacements. Any pending/overflow state is incomplete.
capacities.byte_count_meaning: 128 files/8 MiB is retained model-authored out/ inventory at freeze, not cumulative write volume. Actual Write/Edit operations and cumulative written bytes are separately reported from native traces. Host-derived snapshots/reports do not consume model-authored capacity.

evaluation.observed_effort: future native receipt; unknown until authorized execution
evaluation.admission: Only pairs whose BOTH original arms have native goal_complete and structurally complete, faithful, nonempty nondiagnostic current reports. Otherwise skip that pair premium call, retain all candidate failures/usage, mark semantic outcomes unassessed. No singleton/raw-output diagnosis or replacement; unused capacity not transferred.
evaluation.dispatcher: tools/evaluator_dispatch.py, approval-bound full composed text; never immutable task alone
evaluation.launch_authorization: Separate actual user authorization binding NEW FREEZE.json and exact admitted finite schedule; no existing D1/I1 authority reused
evaluation.chronology: Scoped first_view then fixed first judgments then deferred in same readable workspace; prompt-only and possible format unblinding disclosed

limits_note: I1 ceilings unchanged, no present spending authorized. 14400 seconds includes all scheduling/startup/waits/cleanup/host work; per-slot maxima are not guaranteed allocations. Refuse any slot without its whole cap+300s reserve; unused capacity never transferred.
